Mr. Obaidul Haque Shaheen with Mr. Md. Ashraf-Uz-Zaman Khan, Advocates ------ For the Petitioner.

parties:
Azizur Rahman
Vs.
The Administrator of Waqf and others
full_judgment: 2. The petitioner is the Mutwalli of Sk. Ibrahim Waqf Estate bearing E.C. No. 12017(Sylhet). One Sk. Mohammad Ibrahim created a Waqf-Fi-Safilillah by deed No.10/69 on 12.06.1276 B.S. corresponding to 28.10.1869 A.D. containing terms and conditions that 1/4 of the annual income will be expended for renovation as well as other maintenance and the rest 3/4 of the annual income will be expended for the salvation of the Wakif's departed soul, i.e. for the benefit in the next world and the Wakif appointed 3 persons, namely. Md. Hosen, Sahar Ullah and Raihan Ali to act as joint mutwallis under his supervision until his departure from this world and after his death, the joint mutwallis will act in accordance with the provisions of Waqf deed and the said mutwallis will appoint the next mutwalli and the all existing mutwallis will abide by the terms and conditions of the Waqf deed. The Wakif was the Chief Executive of the Waqf Estate till his death and amongst the joint mutwallis Md. Hosen and Saharullah died one after another and the remaining joint mutwalli Raihan Ali successfully acted as mutwalli for a long time and thereafter Hajee Kudratullah was appointed as Mutwalli by Taliatnama dated 23.07.1312 B.S. and the said mutwalli by another Taliatnama dated 9.04.1937 A.D. appointed his wife Hajee Zahura Bibi as mutwalli of the Waqf Estate who took steps for enrolment of the Waqf Estate with the Office of the Waqfs Administrator, Dhaka in 1950. Then she voluntarily resigned from the post of Mutwalli on 2.09.1970 and handed over the charge of the Mutwalli to the petitioner on 2.09.1970. The petitioner was appointed as the sole Mutwalli of the Waqf Estate bearing E.C. No.12017 (Sylhet) by order contained in Memo.328-902 dated 16.07.1971 issued by the predecessor of the respondent no. 1. The aforesaid mutwallis performed the respective duties perfectly, honestly and sincerely. Thereafter the respondent no.1 by order dated 18.05.1987 illegally formed a 3 member Mutwalli Committee impleading the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Rev.) Sylhet as Chairman which was under challenge in Misc. Appeal No.139 of 1987 in the Court of District Judge, Sylhet. The respondent no.1 by his order dated 27.06.1996 again appointed the Waqf Inspector, Sylhet as Official Mutwalli and removed the present petitioner from the post of Mutwalli. The petitioner was constrained to prefer Civil Suit No.98 of 1996 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge Sylhet for a declaration that the order dated 27.06.1996 is illegal and void. The present petitioner has been working as Mutwalli of the Waqf Estate since 16.07.1971 honestly and sincerely. He filed an application on 11.11.1996 with a prayer, amongst others, for eviction of the present respondent no. 3 from the Waqf property. The respondent no. 1 directed the Assistant Administrator of Waqf (Administration), Dhaka to inquire and report by order under Memo no. 597/C: dated 12.12.1996 and accordingly, physical enquiry was held on 19.12.1996 and the allegations were found correct as reflected in the enquiry report dated 17.03.1997. It is stated that one M/s. Kanai Lal Surana & Babu Lal Surana, a business establishment was a tenant in a residential house of the Waqf Estate since British period. The said tenant M/s. Kanai Lal Surana and Babu Lal Surana closed down their business and left for India and thereafter the Government of Pakistan declared the said business establishment including landed property and the residential house of the said business establishment as enemy property. The then Mutwalli Haji Zahura Bibi instituted Title Suit No.81 of 1969 in the 2nd Court of Subordinate Judge, Sylhet for declaration that the property in question is not an enemy property, rather the same is the Waqf Property. The suit was decreed in favour of the Waqf Estate. Thereafter the present petitioner was appointed Mutwalli by the order dated 16.07.1971. The petitioner as Mutwalli of the Waqf Estate prayed to the Deputy Commissioner, Sylhet for releasing the property from the list of Enemy Properties whereupon the Deputy Commissioner, Sylhet in the light of the judgment and decree passed in Title Suit No.81 of 1969 directed the tenants to hand over the vacant possession to the petitioner. Though the other tenants accepted the Waqf Estate as landlord but the husband of the respondent no. 3 did not comply with the said order of the Deputy Commissioner, Sylhet. It is stated that under the illegal management of the Waqf property as enemy property by the Assistant Custodian, Enemy Cell, Sylhet, the husband of the respondent no.3 entered in the residential house of the Waqf Estate as lessee from the Enemy Property Authority and he had not handed over the vacant possession of the said property, rather he had filed Title Suit No.139 of 1982 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Sadar, Sylhet for declaration and permanent injunction, but the said suit was dismissed on contest. After his death his wife, respondent no. 3, as the appellant preferred Title Appeal No.34 o 1986 in the Court of the District Judge, Sylhet and taking the advantage of the pending of Title Appeal No. 34 of 1986 the respondent no.3 by constructing some kutcha huts illegally showing herself as landlady inducted tenants therein. The petitioner as Mutwalli on several occasions by written applications brought the illegal activities of the respondent no.3 to the knowledge of the respondent no.1 and the matter was inquired into by the Subordinate Officials of the respondent no. 1. On the prayer of the petitioner, the respondent no.1 by his judgment and order dated 30.03.1997 (Annexure-F) directed the respondent no.4 to take action under Section 64(1) of the Waqfs Ordinance 1962 for eviction of the respondent no. 3. Thereafter the respondent no. 3 preferred Writ Petition No.2119 of 1997 before the High Court Division challenging the judgment and order dated 30.03.1997 impleading the respondent no.1 and 5 respectively and obtained a Rule Nisi and an order of stay of the operation of the order dated 30.03.1997 till disposal of the Rule by order dated 29.04.1997. The said Rule was pending for hearing. It is further stated that suppressing the facts of the Writ Petition No.2119 of 1997, the respondent No.3 on 16.02.1998 filed an application for review of the order dated 30.03.1997 (Annexure-G) before the respondent no.1 to take necessary action relating to her stay in the Waqf Property. The respondent no.1 without giving the petitioner any opportunity of being unheard most arbitrarily and illegally stayed the eviction order dated 30.03.1997 by the impugned order dated 19.03.1998 (Annexure-H). The respondent no. 2 communicated the said order to the petitioner by his letter under Memo. No.3: প্র: / সিলেট/ ১৪০৯-/ ১৪০৮ {১-৩} dated 23.03.1998 (Annexure-I).
